releases.notes:
## Changes

- Add individual Fabric, Forge and NeoForge builds for Minecraft 1.21 through 26.3.
- Add NeoForge support.
- Fix command replacement, player death handling and death statistics.
- Fix UTF-8 configuration loading, malformed permission settings and Folia error handling.

- Marked the Forge artifact as server-side only.

releases.notes:
## Downloads
Use the Bukkit jar for Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Purpur, Folia, and similar servers.
Use the Fabric or Forge jar that matches your exact Minecraft version.

## Changes
- Added Bukkit-compatible, Fabric, and Forge artifacts.
- Added configurable command name and aliases.
supports: minecraft 1.21.1 paper, bukkit, folia servers
